scope.root_domain: core primes p congruent to 1 modulo 24

kernel_theorems.name: H4 clean-q a=1 relative macro closure
kernel_theorems.statement: For an actual parent-anchored proper-overlap top-capacity H4 receipt with a_alt=1 and verified terminal-priority miss, the clean-q macro supplies a phase-local E1-E5 candidate transition or terminal under the written guard.
does_not_claim: all descendants have a total continuation

kernel_theorems.name: finite atomic-admission grammar
kernel_theorems.statement: The frozen atomic surface A_v1=A_H4 disjoint-union A_C8 has a deterministic receipt grammar for the H4 a=1 actual arm and the conditional c=8 double-low arm.

kernel_theorems.name: current registered graph has no nontrivial-mark seed
kernel_theorems.statement: Starting from root mark Sol(p), neither the initializer nor any of the 15 registered edge generators targets generic_nontrivial_marked_state; direct terminals use the root-certificate disjunction. Hence a nontrivial marked state is unreachable in the frozen named graph.
reopen_conditions: a registered edge targets a nontrivial marked family
the initializer creates a nontrivial mark
a terminal is accepted only in a changed equation fiber
does_not_claim: an abstract membership theorem for every future mark

kernel_theorems.name: ordinary q>=1 G fresh-source handoff
kernel_theorems.statement: Every actual terminal-first ordinary G endpoint with mark Sol(p) satisfying the written q=1 or positive-q receipt guard has a target-independent full-carrier Type I fresh-root handoff and the registered first strict local segment.

kernel_theorems.name: contract-admitted recursive graph is well founded
kernel_theorems.statement: Every admitted verified_edge carries OUTER_RANK_DROP, PHASE_DROP, or LOCAL_DROP and strictly decreases the fixed N^7 potential.
does_not_claim: every E1-E4 candidate receives a ticket
every reachable nonterminal state has an edge

legacy_strong_formulations.description: all actual raw paths and future atomic surfaces
abstract membership for any future nontrivial mark

mechanical_closures.proof: 15 unique registered edge generators; every source and target is a named family
no initializer or edge targets generic_nontrivial_marked_state
manifest and CI reject an unregistered family, an unknown target, or a marked target without explicit reopen obligations
T1v1-T5v1 carry explicit scopes and no kernel theorem claims T6 or F0
outer archive digest and detached payload evidence are authoritative; the embedded self-hash is explicitly non-authoritative
